<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

All declared query operations and formats are exposed through the real injectable CLI frontend with bundled recipes and actionable outcomes; no new native registry or CLI-owned semantic engine. Real parser, serializer and frontend behavior with shared core facts and then SDK composition; no assertion that authored fixtures alone prove an installed binary.
